summary: RETEST P0 of /technician grouping fix (2nd attempt). Fix VERIFIED. slotSectionId now correctly prioritizes labelKeywords BEFORE role. As Carlos Técnico, BUGTST slot with role='polarizado' + label='Corte' appears in the Corte tab (badge=1) with 'Finalizar y enviar reporte' button. Instalación tab (badge=2) shows only true Instalación slots: BUGTST Instalación (pendiente, 'Iniciar servicio') + TEC001 Polarizado (regression preserved via 'polariz' keyword). Global alerts header shows '3 servicio(s) pendiente(s)' (N>=2 as required). critical_code_review_comments: Minor: after finishing a slot, the completed card still remains in its tab panel (bySection includes 'completado' status while alertsBySection excludes it). Corte badge drops to 0 but the card still visible with 'Completado' badge. This may be intended (tech can see what they finished today) but consider filtering completed to a separate 'Historial' tab or auto-hiding after N minutes.
seed_data_creation: None. BUGTST order was pre-seeded/reset by main agent with 2 slots (Corte en_proceso + Instalación pendiente) both assigned to Carlos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The slotSectionId fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/TechnicianView.jsx (L32-41) — labelKeywords first, then role fallback — is confirmed working. Verified: (a) custom-labeled slot ('Corte' label + 'polarizado' role) routes to Corte tab; (b) generic 'Polarizado' label routes to Instalación via 'polariz' keyword — regression preserved; (c) finish dialog + submit works end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Original bug: role-first matching caused role='polarizado' to always route to Instalación, ignoring custom label 'Corte'. Fix: invert priority in slotSectionId — first find section whose labelKeywords match the slot.label, otherwise fall back to role match. Since 'Corte' label contains 'corte' keyword (Corte section) it now routes there; 'Polarizado' label contains 'polariz' (Instalación section) so regular slots still route correctly.
